newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sui Chong says not aware why shrs rising.
newsitem.headline: Sui Chong says not aware why shrs rising.

text.p: Sui Chong Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was not aware of any reasons for the recent rise in the price and trading volume of its shares except for its talks with an independent third party regarding property deals.

"We are not aware of any reasons for such increases except for negotiations relating to intended acquisitions or realisations of properties by the company with an independent third party," the company said in a statement responding to the stock exchange's request for information.
"Such negotiations are at a preliminary stage and the transactions may or may not materialise," it said.
The construction and property firm made a similar statement on March 7 after trade in its shares was suspended by the exchange for one day on March 6.
Last week the company said it was in negotiations to buy properties from an independent third party.
Sui Chong shares were up HK$0.19, or 16 percent, to HK$1.33 just before the midday break on Friday after jumping more than 60 percent to HK$1.14 on Thursday.
The shares have soared nearly 200 percent in the past two weeks.
